name: B · 冷艳克制
detail: Preserve cool phoenix eyes, sleek high ponytail, moon-white long split wrap costume, narrow sleeves, curved slender dao pointing down left. Change EVERY blue/indigo clothing accent and ribbon to rich crimson red. Keep moon-white and gray neutrals. Especially shorten the elongated legs and enlarge the head to the project compact ratio. Elegant vertical crescent silhouette but compact.
prompt: Use case: style-transfer and precise character redesign. Produce ONE full-body standalone Chinese wuxia female dao fighter, clearly an ADULT woman. Image1 is the target candidate: preserve her individual identity, personality, outfit cut, feminine bust-waist-hip curves, weapon identity and pose idea. Image2 is AUTHORITATIVE for compact game-character proportions, stylized eyes and outline/shading. Image3 is gem-icon painting style. Redraw the whole figure to unify with image2: visibly larger head, short neck, compact torso and MUCH SHORTER legs, about 3.5 head heights crown-to-sole (not counting ponytail). Keep an adult woman's face and mature soft curvy physique; never a child. Do not retain the 6-7 head tall anime fashion proportions from image1. Keep curving feminine silhouette, avoid muscular pectoral anatomy or hard polygonal skin. Bold consistent dark contour; large coherent colored planes, only 2-3 purposeful shadow shapes per material; a few broad bevel highlights. No noisy tiny triangles, no fragmented folds or hair strands, no realistic eyes. Chinese costume design, red color accents only with black, ivory, muted gold/silver neutrals. Sparse large ornament; clear shape rhythm. Three-quarter view facing SCREEN LEFT. Preserve cool phoenix eyes, sleek high ponytail, moon-white long split wrap costume, narrow sleeves, curved slender dao pointing down left. Change EVERY blue/indigo clothing accent and ribbon to rich crimson red. Keep moon-white and gray neutrals. Especially shorten the elongated legs and enlarge the head to the project compact ratio. Elegant vertical crescent silhouette but compact. Entire head, weapon tips and feet inside square canvas with generous 8% margin. Warm ivory plain background, no floor shadow, no lettering, no panel, no extra figures. The output must look from the SAME compact stylized RPG roster as image2, with gem-icon graphic clarity.
